systems.owner: operador da rede privativa do Estado, to be set up by the Executive's own instrument
systems.tiers: by law for the exclusive use of public administration; its operator is to interlink the private networks of the organs of central and local state administration

systems.owner: the State; managed and operated by Angola Telecom, E.P. under the transitional article

note: The 2011 electronic communications law: it defines the state's private network and requires that all public administration services be interlinked over it (arts. 20 and 32), as a legal duty; it states no local government office as connected and gives no figure.
